reason: A browser-based voice input utility for DSH that converts microphone speech to chat text through the Web Speech API, with optional automatic sending and multilingual settings.

summaries.zh: 通过浏览器内置 Web Speech API 将麦克风语音转换为 DSH 聊天输入文字，并支持实时识别、追加文本和松手自动发送。
summaries.en: Converts microphone speech into DSH chat input text through the browser’s built-in Web Speech API, with live recognition, text appending, and optional send-on-release.

capabilities: accesses microphone input with browser permission
uses the browser Web Speech API for speech recognition
sends speech data to the browser-selected speech service
inserts recognized text into the chat input
can optionally send recognized text automatically when recording stops
